title: Hollow Congregation: 42 PSX Horror Characters + FPS Sprites
shortText: 42 PS1-style horror characters; 14 also ship as 8-direction FPS enemy sprites.
priceNote: three packs on one page, list sum $24.97 (Hollow Congregation $8.99, Saint Oswin $7.99, Eight Angles $7.99); $8.99 = 36% of it (volume rule: at or under 60%); the page has SOLD at $8.99 (5 purchases), so the price stays (a sold listing is never repriced off a guess)

descriptionHtml:
Want the whole set? The PSX Character Library holds the CSAF PSX character packs on one page, plus every new one, for $19.99.

42 PS1-style horror characters for Godot 4, Unity and Unreal: 14 cultists, 14 asylum staff and patients, and 14 retro FPS enemies that also ship as 8-direction sprites. One purchase, all three packs, a free sampler of each. Every character is rigged to the same humanoid skeleton with the same 45 animation clips, about 1,500 triangles and one 256 px texture per skin, in GLB, FBX, OBJ and Blender formats. If you bought this page before, Eight Angles is already in your itch library at no extra cost.

Eight Angles: 14 retro FPS enemies, as sprites and as models (added November 2026)

  • A shooter's bestiary: possessed trooper, frost witch, mutant brute, cyborg gunner, cult acolyte, ghoul, shock trooper, fire fiend, berserker, rune knight, hazmat spitter, bone shaman, bronze automaton and husk marine. All adults.
  • 8-direction billboard sprites: 210 sheets and 11,424 frames of idle, walk, attack, pain and death, at one pixel scale with hard alpha and a sprites.json per enemy (frame size, pivot).
  • A Godot 4 node and demo: EightDirectionSprite picks the row from the camera angle; open the Eight Angles folder in Godot and press F5.
  • 3 skins each (42 to place), with sprites for every skin.

Saint Oswin: 14 asylum staff and patients (added November 2026)

  • A whole institution: the director, head nurse, orderly, psychiatrist, night nurse, night warden, chaplain, surgeon, maintenance man, investigator, ward patient, striped patient, long-stay patient and sleepless patient. Every one an adult.
  • Modelled caps on the head nurse, the night warden and the maintenance man, not painted.
  • 3 skins each (42 to place): scrubs, pyjamas and uniforms change colour as a set; cardigans and jackets change alone; faces, hair and shoes keep their paint.
  • Honest limit: the hands are simple mittens and nothing is held; keys hang on belts and the journalist's bag is painted on a strap.

Hollow Congregation: 14 cultists

  • The faithful of a small rural cult: high priest, the vessel, masked executioner, sister of the congregation, acolyte, the chosen, chanter, converted orderly, groundskeeper, converted deputy, penitent, matriarch, scribe and bell ringer.
  • 3 palette skins each (42 to place): a black vestment becomes oxblood or dark green; trim, bone charms, leather, hair and skin keep their paint.
  • Rites on the same skeleton: four spell clips read as rites, a slow formal walk for processions, a torch idle and a sword attack for the executioner.

Every character, all three packs

  • 45 animation clips plus a T-pose: idle, walks, jog, sprint, crouch, jump, roll, punches, 6 pistol clips, sword, spell, hit reactions, a death, sit, swim, talking and more.
  • PSX ready: 15-bit textures for nearest filtering and a PSX shader for Godot 4 (vertex snap, affine warp, dither, fog).
  • Files: a GLB per skin, FBX with the skeleton and clips, OBJ, and the Blender source.

Works with

Godot 4: copy models/ and shaders/ into the project and instance a _skin0.glb. All three packs were imported into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project: every GLB imports, the shader compiles and the clips play (Godot names Walk_Loop as Walk and loops it).

Unity 6 and Unreal 5: import the FBX and set the textures to point filtering; the skeleton retargets with Unity Humanoid or an Unreal IK Rig. Not run here; every FBX was re-imported in Blender (mesh, 53 bones, every clip).

Try it free

Three free demo files on this page: the Hollow Congregation high priest, the Saint Oswin head nurse and the Eight Angles fire fiend (with its sprites and the Godot demo), each with every skin, every clip, every format and the shader. Try more free first: the PSX Characters Sampler has one character from each of our PSX packs.

Licence and how it was made

Use the models in any number of commercial or free games, with no attribution and no royalty, and modify them freely. Do not resell or redistribute the models, textures or animations themselves as assets.

Every character here was made with AI tools. The bodies were built with MakeHuman (CC0 output) by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh (Saint Oswin and Eight Angles: FLUX.2 klein); the Eight Angles sprites are renders of those models. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library. Code: yes. Graphics: yes. Sounds: no. Text: no.

Versions

1.3: Eight Angles added, 14 retro FPS enemies as sprites and models, November 2026. 1.2: Saint Oswin added, November 2026. 1.1.0: every body rebuilt; 1.0.0: first release, October 2026.
